name: MLPerf v6.1 Dell R770 2x Xeon 6787P: llama3.1-8b INT8 Offline aggregate tok/s

INT8 weights, FP8 KV. measured_by vendor: these are submitter results inside the MLCommons closed division (Intel, Dell, Supermicro, Quanta, Red Hat, Cisco), not an independent re-run.
